_template: PROPOSED, NOT BUILT: a SLATE Delve whose one place is an orbit, dealt from the remote-space branch. Eliza's. The space kind is the ladder's harness (one silent use, started by hand, pays nothing); this is it graduating as boardspace did for the board, the ladder spike's exit (b). His 62 duo_artifact_remote_qst* are the prior art, and the space shell is one of them (qst03a) already.
_deal: The remote-space branch's test node; the real one is duo_MS_ArtifactMap_RemoteSpaceNode.
author: jessica
source: his 2026-10-26 10:48: "Another mission needed to fill the last gap: RemoteSpace: needs a slate space template; nothing for it yet."
_note: THE FIRST REMOTE-SPACE SLATE DELVE. A freighter went dark in orbit; its crew got off in the pods, and its flight
recorder is still pinging. Fly out and pull it. ONE use, the one thing an orbit Delve is proven to carry.
A SLATE, so the broadcast plays when the quest starts (BeginOnQuestStart, never stage 0's fragment), and the opening
line does not say how the job arrived (remote06a's rule). The client calls; the closing line is the radio.
Not a satellite on purpose: 26a to 29a are satellites. MODEL: Satellite_Beacon is the only object proven in orbit, so it
stands in; a wreck section or a recorder beacon is his or Kim's pick.

LINT as 'space' (2026-10-26): speech, the say, the reward and <Planet> are refused (space supplies only <Place>, the orbit itself). boardspace supplies <Planet> off the orbit; slatespace wants the same, or say which token and I reword.

place._altitude: 26a's, MB01e's: the altitude that filled. Eliza's to say whether a slate orbit wants another.

prose.name: Recovery: Flight Recorder over <Planet>
prose.briefing: A freighter went dark in orbit over <Planet>. Its crew got off in the pods, and its flight recorder is still pinging.

beats.objective: Recover the flight recorder from the wreck over <Planet>
beats.journal: A freighter went dark over <Planet> and its crew got off in the pods. I pulled its flight recorder out of the wreck, so somebody can finally say what happened.
beats._model: STAND-IN: the only object proven in orbit.
beats.name: Flight Recorder
say: You've got it? Then we'll finally know.
The crew will be glad. They've been telling the same story to anyone who'll listen.

broadcast: If you're near the wreck, you'll pick up the ping. That's the recorder.
The crew got off in the pods. The ship didn't.
They swear they did nothing wrong. The recorder's the only thing that can say so.
_speech: The ship's owner, who believes her crew and wants proof. Bella (Professional, Bright, Warm), in one recipe so far; his ear decides. No names, places, factions or currency.
